It features two columns of text listing food items and prices. The text appears to be in a serif font, but the characters are largely illegible, resembling gibberish or pseudo-text rather than real words. There are small decorative icons (possibly stylized vegetables or utensils) interspersed between sections. The lighting is somewhat dim, casting shadows across the fold.
